open_prs.title: Cap Cheaper Recruitment at 20 and preserve old purchase value
open_prs.body:
Cheaper Recruitment explains the 40% normal-price floor (at most 60% discount, before existing whole-Lumen rounding), stops purchases at its existing effective level-20 cap, and retains historical raw levels. Old purchases above 20 return their original Prism value once; amounts that cannot be added exactly remain spendable credits. Invalid/partial/unsupported refund records use existing save recovery.

The shared Tree planner preserves catalog identity, unlock, retirement, Echo cap and price guards while checking exact wallet/credit debits. Internal auto-Ascends retain untouched validated F21 records; loads, imports and saves still validate fully. Save schema 2, foreign records, gameplay prices, progression, Motes and signing identity are preserved.

Final source 38594553, combined main 06b28d5: 553 focused assertions/26 result groups, 12 causal controls and V8 6.0 pass. Tests include 14,400 actual auto-Ascends with exact record preservation and canonical parity, repeated old-backup restores, malformed-record recovery, 320/390/430px, 200% text, 44px controls, touch/keyboard/focus/contrast and reduced motion. Existing chronology and 16-record offline catch-up checks pass on the performance fix; final full CI covers combined bytes with all 176 scenarios, Rift cosmetics, 10 F21 defect controls and 17 existing harness negatives.

All reported automated P1/P2 findings have scoped corrections and regression evidence. Self-review is not independent review. An earlier CI browser-startup failure is retained honestly; corrected browser priority records actual executable/version.

Final required CI, integration, signed APK identity/assets and actual Android update acceptance remain pending. Signed APK143 baseline preserves 21 real paid purchases19→40 and a cold-persisted save. Completion evidence: docs/tasks/CHEAPER_BONDS_CAP_001.md and docs/qa/cheaper-bonds-cap-001/finish/.

open_prs.title: Cap Swift Recovery at level 10 and preserve legacy purchase value
open_prs.body:
Swift Recovery now stops purchases at level 10 and uses the same effective cap for UI previews, direct/bulk/Max/queue purchases and live/offline ability fill. The minimum cycle is 10/3 seconds. Ready resources, current charge percentage and paid Resonate retain their behavior.

Old raw levels, earned Deeds, queue intent and paid Study work remain. Purchases above 10 receive their approved original single-price Shard value once. Exact same-currency credit preserves small refunds beside huge wallets, all Shard purchases, primary/recovery saves and full backup replacement. Product JavaScript uses no BigInt.

**Blocked on the pending Deed progression choice; do not integrate yet.** Main PR90 retires the other four original Forge buying tracks, so cap10 makes the existing Forge20/60 Deeds unreachable for new players. The user has been asked whether future completed levels in their four replacement Lab tracks should count, retaining both thresholds/rewards and granting no retroactive Lab credit. The complete baseline/save proposal is in docs/qa/swift-recovery-cap-001/implementation/deed-continuity-proposal.md; it is not implemented pending the answer.

The candidate preserves main14d5f3a, including PR84/90, remembered Forge bulk, shared12h offline/schema2 and stable Rift guidance. Swift receipt v1 coexists with the F26 refund ledger. Paid Study work uses the canonical clock to prevent event-subtraction drift; durations, speeds and existing tolerances stay intact. Approved F18 duration implementation remains separate.

Current source SHA256: 319e69db68f96f30e4d5b1a56ae15101c9fba21552d09c79ac2e8d3601ff6916. Focused validation passes:14 core groups/110 budget/boundary purchases; five causal mutants; shared12h regression; complete offline replay against independent one-second8h/12h references and the exact adapted frozen engine;12 mobile/text/motion profiles; actual V8 6.0 plus independent integer accounting; source/tooling/context checks. Full current-head CI remains required. Earlier full162 and17 negatives are source-labelled; the obsolete main31 full run was stopped after the12h merge and is not a current full-pass claim.

Signed baseline143 installed bytes, old level12 save, real cold launch and native storage preparation pass with Auto-Empower OFF. No Swift APK has been released. Integration, final Deed continuity regression, current-head CI and signed APK/native update acceptance remain open. No independent review, physical Android, TalkBack or exact WebView60 device result is claimed.

Durable task: docs/tasks/SWIFT_RECOVERY_CAP_001.md. Evidence: docs/qa/swift-recovery-cap-001/implementation/checkpoint-main14d5f3a.json and README.md. Keep this owner chat open while required acceptance is blocked.

open_prs.title: SUPPORT_UPTIME_001: enforce Tide/Aurora downtime and preserve Swift value
open_prs.body:
Tide and Aurora currently cast 4-second normal / 8-second Ultimate buffs on a 6-second base cycle, allowing permanent support. The approved design changes future casts to 1s / 1.5s and caps effective Swift Recovery at 10 (minimum cycle 10/3s). At charge 0/5/10, Ultimate uptime is 25/35/45% per support and at most 50/70/90% for both, ensuring at least 10% sustained downtime at the cap. Strength remains additive +25/+50%; existing paid Ultimates and earned expiry deadlines remain.

Keep historical Swift levels and refund individually rounded original prices above 10 once. Shared forge.charge receipts and exact spendable decimal Shard credits preserve refunds beside huge Number balances across purchases, queues, saves, recovery, backup and Ascend. No Sigil refund or other balance/schema changes are added; incoming schema2/common12h, Lab, Formation, Loadout, Rift cosmetics and upgrade ownership changes are retained.

Short buffs exposed caller-boundary drift in the shared clock. Canonical 100ms cuts, split clock coordinates and ephemeral Study work anchors restore strict live/offline/split/save parity without changing rewards. The independent frozen engine retains its prices, rewards and ordering; its clock/work adapter keeps full exact comparisons. The original strict Inquiry oracle is restored.

Validation on source SHA256 59cbadb32d7288350498816f28292468082c6a8359ed397af752ccd94e9b6fd2: motor 2,127 checks / 49 combinations / 98 fractional / 50 phase cases; 2,998 strict economy checks; full offline core; exact paid Lab work and focused Inquiry/Lab/Swift/support checks; mobile 320/390/430, 200% text, 44px controls, focus/contrast/reduced motion; actual V8 6.0 motor and 46 exact currency checks. Old-source causal failure, failed experiments and prior CI dispositions are retained in docs/qa/support-uptime-001/implementation. Self-review and automated validation only.

Final full CI on e4e862c, integrated-source verification and the established signed main APK/native old-save update are pending. Task and decisions: docs/tasks/SUPPORT_UPTIME_001.md and its linked evidence. This PR is not feature completion.

open_prs.title: WISP_ROLES_001: show Wisp contributions and preserve Farm clock phase
open_prs.body:
Titan's reported dominance and the other Wisps' value are hard to assess from their existing Power labels. This draft adds a Formation contribution preview and per-Wisp readouts for raw damage, marginal support, enabled Bonds, actual resource rewards and one-Wisp removal impact. The additive ledger counts shared effects once; overlapping removal comparisons are explicitly separate.

Equal-budget Farm replays also exposed two existing clock precision failures. The candidate detects progress on the canonical grid and computes whole seconds and the endpoint fraction separately, preserving elapsed damage, purchases and rewards. A fixed clock-only oracle retains exact complete-state/summary comparisons; reverting the correction fails both the oracle and HP parity.

Validation:
- CI [37711347792](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/actions/runs/37711347792) passed on 48f9c15: 150 default scenarios, all 12 required negative controls, source/tooling and guarded startup. Fresh [CI37713826966](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/actions/runs/37713826966) is running on 7284cf7 with the stricter oracle and current-main merge (151 default scenarios).
- Core 3,249 checks across 56 teams/four contexts and 12 live/offline clock controls pass. The same checks pass on unmodified product JavaScript in V8 6.0.286.52.
- Mobile 320/390/430px, 200% text, focus, contrast, controls >=44px and reduced motion pass. Full long-offline, cancellation/restart, storage failure, recovery/backup and processing-time checks pass with exact revised golden values.
- Raw results and precise source identities are saved in docs/qa/wisp-roles-001/; docs/tasks/WISP_ROLES_001.md and PROJECT_STATE record continuation.

The Ember/Stone Veteran Power curve is calibrated and awaiting the user's concrete choice; it is not implemented. The supplied backup is post-Ascend, so powered actual mid/late-game team evidence remains unavailable. open_prs.title: Implement and verify the 27-feature feedback bundle
open_prs.body:
The 27 original TXT requirements are preserved and mapped to code and acceptance evidence. This draft has 21 implemented/existing rows and six pending rows for Comet replacements, campaign pacing, the common matrix and its Lab/Forge/Tree parts. Existing Forge exclusive caps are verified, but those alone do not complete the agreed-matrix requirement.

The candidate includes mobile UI changes, Formation autosave, eight Bonds, bounded older-Wisp catch-up, approved Swift/Echo/Bonds caps, approved support durations, the shared 12-hour productive offline limit and original-currency refunds. Current main Wisp/Forge/Bond text and Cast-status accessibility improvements are preserved.

Required CI37714789186 passed 151 deterministic scenarios, all 12 required negative controls, source/tooling/APK-identity-verifier gates and runtime smoke on head20e877c1 and PR test-merge45574115. Its production SHA256 matches the current candidate. Supplementary/native checks cover mobile geometry, save/recovery, long offline/restart, equal-budget Wisps and real negative mutations. Subsequent heads and final integration still require their own checks.

Requirements and the reviewable two pending gameplay choices are in docs/requirements/all-27-feedback-001. Durable CI evidence and the 27-item phone checklist are in docs/qa/all-27-feedback-001; the continuation is docs/tasks/ALL_27_FEEDBACK_001.md. Keep this draft open until those answers, all six remaining implementations/pacing, required final validation and signed APK delivery are complete. Zero features are labeled released complete.
